_what: Reusable words a person sends again and again (src/snippets.mjs): a reply they give often, an introduction, a sign-off. A snippet is a saved piece of writing with a title, its words and optional tags; `{name}` in its words is a named blank filled when it is used. Everything that varies is a row here: the record type, the blank's pattern, the sizes and every word shown.

words.needs_title: A snippet needs a title (what you call it when you look for it).
words.too_many: An account keeps at most {max} snippets. Remove one first.
words.missing: There is no snippet {snippet_id}. list_snippets shows them.
words.stale: {snippet_id} was saved again at {set_at}, not at {expected}, since you read it. Read it again with list_snippets and edit from what it shows now.
